notes: The floor arrows now lead to what you can do right now: with the money for a pad in hand they point at that pad, not at an older step.
Pods lying side by side get one arrow loop around the whole group, so you can tow them together.
Walls now fade together when they hide your commander, and so does every building except the grow dome and the warehouse. The green outline is gone.
Level wins end with a real fireworks show.
Raiders fire red bolts, and defenders, hunters and turrets fire blue ones.
A green medical cross fills over a guard while a medic heals them.
A trader's order now shows a picture of the item they want.
Your commander digs with a shovel while paying to clear a blocked zone.
